prompts: Same prompts and code as the béchamel sessions; nothing recipe-specific was changed.

questions.text: I see your golden Spanish omelette ready on the counter. What did you put in it and how much of each?
I can't see anything of a known size to measure the pan. How wide is it across?
When you tipped it out, how did you know it was ready to come out?

observations_sample.observation: A golden-brown Spanish omelette rests on a white plate, seen close up.
You are holding a potato on a wooden board and peeling it, with peels gathering on the board.
You are cutting peeled potatoes into small pieces and collecting them in a clear bowl on a white table.
You pour oil into the pan, then add small pieces of potato to the cold oil.
You pour oil over the cut potatoes in the pan and then stir them with a wooden spoon.
You lift cooked potato cubes from the pan onto paper, then crack eggs into a white bowl with several yolks already in it.
You whisk beaten eggs in a white bowl, then stir cooked potatoes into egg in a glass bowl.
You pour the potato and egg mixture from the bowl into the hot pan and spread it with the wooden spoon.
You hold the golden omelette over the pan, then slide it back into the pan.
You hold the pan with the browned tortilla next to an empty plate, then it is on the plate.
